name: studyId
label: Study ID
help: Select a Study or map a Study ID from an earlier module.

name: request
label: Research request
help: What you want to learn, in plain language. Minds turns it into questions for the Study’s Minds.

name: studyLocale
label: Study language
help: Language of the plan and of the eventual study output.

name: material
label: Material to review
help: Optional material the Minds react to, such as ad copy, an image or a webpage.

nested.name: sourceContent
nested.label: Text
nested.help: Exact text the Minds react to, such as ad copy or a landing page headline.

nested.name: sourceUrl
nested.label: URL
nested.help: A public HTTPS image, video, PDF or webpage URL. Links that require sign-in cannot be imported.

name: sourceLabel
label: Material label
help: Optional short name for the material, such as "Landing page copy".

name: idempotencyKey
label: Preview request identifier
help: Optional stable ID from the source event, such as a row ID. Reusing it returns the saved draft instead of planning again. Use a new ID when the Study, request or material changes.
